$comment: Preset 'inline-workers' for installer/init.mjs (--preset inline-workers). HAND-MAINTAINED (unlike the derived presets): the /tmp/gen-presets.mjs generator is not in-repo, so regeneration would drop this file. The inline delegation family — the inline plan executor plus the 4 inline decision-tree skills, the in-session code-review wrapper (code-review-inline-skill), the architecture-review-skill decision-tree reviewer (the /run-worktree-pipeline Step 7 inline architecture-review route), the in-session requirements delegate with its detection gate (requirements-inline-skill), and the Step 10 PR route (civiltekk-pr-workflow-skill create route + its runtime deps ticketing-skill, semantic-release-convention-skill, gh-cli-setup-skill — dependency-map.json has no requiresSkills coverage for the PR skill, so preset membership is the closure), plus their knowledge-skill dependency closure (the closure rides preset membership for the knowledge skills; the 4 workers + plan-execution-inline-skill are ALSO covered by dependency-map.json requiresSkills edges), plus the reviewer baselines the /run-worktree-pipeline inline-review arm names explicitly and the code-review checklist's core knowledge skills. Opt-in: default setup.sh deploy is unaffected.
name: inline-workers
description: Inline delegation family — plan-execution-inline-skill, the testing/linting/documentation/responsive-audit inline skills, the in-session code-review wrapper (code-review-inline-skill), the architecture-review-skill decision-tree reviewer, the in-session requirements delegate with its detection gate (requirements-inline-skill), the Step 10 PR route (civiltekk-pr-workflow-skill create route) with its runtime deps, the knowledge skills they defer to, and the reviewer baselines for inline pipeline reviews (reviewer-baseline-skill, language-review-checklists-skill). Companion to the inline-default /run-plan and /run-worktree-pipeline commands on full deploys.
